## Changes

### New
- Merge sources: one bookmark can read from several sources. Order them by dragging; each chapter comes from the first source that has it, so a new chapter shows up from whichever source releases it first. Title, cover and info come from the first source. Merge from the "Already in your library" sheet, or add sources with the merge button on a bookmarked comic's page.
- The chapter list of a merged comic shows each chapter's source, and the source button shows the chapters of one source.
- Migrate to several sources at once: a comic not found in the first is looked up in the next, in the order you drag them.
- "View bookmarked series" in the "Already in your library" sheet opens the bookmark from the other source.

### Changes
- The Uncategorized tab in Bookmarks shows only when a comic has no category.

### Fixes
- The end of a chapter is centered on its page in horizontal reading.
